name: youtube-automation
tagline_zh: 频道更新像上了发条：自动抓热点、剪片段、配字幕、定时发。你只负责定选题，剩下的交给它，连封面都替你选好。
tagline_en: Your channel runs itself: auto-trend-spot, clip, caption, schedule. You pick topics, it handles the rest—even.
desc_en: YouTube チャンネル自動化 共有コア
why_zh: 不是单点工具，而是整套流水线。从选题到发布全链路打通，且每个环节都可替换，适配你的工作流。
why_en: Not a single tool but a full pipeline—from topic to publish, every stage swappable to fit your workflow.
